reason: The new test's Device literal (pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database_test.go:55-60) sets DeviceID, ClientIP, UserAgent and UpdatedAt but not CreatedAt, so the row is stored with a zero created_at (database.go:121).
